js: for (let i=0;i<8;i++){ const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/^(Continue|Start using Ensemble|Get started)$/i.test(b.textContent.trim())); if(!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); } await window.__ensemble.getState().send('Add a pricing page with a checkout flow'); return 'sent'

const st = window.__ensemble; const s = st.getState(); const k = s.chatId + ':' + s.settings.leadId; await s.send('Also make the hero image warmer'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const q = () => (st.getState().items[k] || []).filter(i => i.kind === 'user' && i.queued).map(i => i.text); const before = q(); const ta = document.querySelector('.composer textarea'); ta.focus(); ta.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowUp', code: 'ArrowUp', bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); const inList = (st.getState().items[k] || []).some(i => i.text === 'Also make the hero image warmer'); return 'queued before: ' + JSON.stringify(before) + ' | after Up: box [' + ta.value + '] | chip ' + /Taken back/.test(document.querySelector('.composer').textContent) + ' | still in transcript ' + inList + ' | queued now ' + JSON.stringify(q())

const st = window.__ensemble; const s = st.getState(); const k = s.chatId + ':' + s.settings.leadId; await s.send('Use a softer blue for the buttons'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const item = (st.getState().items[k] || []).find(i => i.kind === 'user' && i.queued); const got = item ? await st.getState().dequeue(s.chatId, s.settings.leadId, item.id) : null; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'x path: took back ' + (got && got.text) + ' | still in transcript ' + (st.getState().items[k] || []).some(i => i.id === (item && item.id))

const st = window.__ensemble; const s = st.getState(); const k = s.chatId + ':' + s.settings.leadId; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const texts = (st.getState().items[k] || []).filter(i => i.kind === 'user').map(i => i.text); const ta = document.querySelector('.composer textarea'); return 'after reload: user rows ' + JSON.stringify(texts) + ' | box [' + (ta && ta.value) + ']'
